description: Queue a security scan for one of the account's targets. Returns a scan_id to poll with get_scan_status. Specify which target with target_id (or domain); if the API key can act on exactly one target it is used by default, otherwise target_id is required (call list_targets to discover options).

domain.description: Convenience alias for target_id: an active target's domain, resolved server-side.

target_id.description: Which target to scan. Optional when the key can act on a single target; required otherwise.

workflow.description: Scan tier to run. Defaults to the account's own subscription tier; requesting a tier above it is rejected.

name: trigger_scan
